# E0424: a projection yields exactly once

A projection hands its caller one place on every path. Yield on each path, or raise or panic on the others.

- Rule: [`projections.once-on-every-path`](../../reference/13-modes.md#projections.once-on-every-path)
- Reported at: the `yield` inside a loop, the second `yield` of a path, or the end of the body or the `return` that a path reaches without one.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `analyses` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0424:5
fn at(inout xs: List<i64>, i: i64) -> inout i64 {
  if i < xs.len() {
    yield xs[i]
  }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn at(inout xs: List<i64>, i: i64) -> inout i64 {
  yield xs[i]
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0424_a_projection_yields_exactly_once.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0424_a_projection_yields_exactly_once.lt):

```text
── A PROJECTION YIELDS EXACTLY ONCE ── E0424_a_projection_yields_exactly_once.lt:5:1  [E0424]

A path through the projection reaches its end without a `yield`: every path
yields exactly once:

  5 │ }
    │ ^

A projection hands its caller one place on every path. Yield on each path, or
raise or panic on the others.
```
